blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) recently earned another international recognition from the prestigious IAIR (International Alternative Investment Review) Awards held in Hong Kong. IAIR is a research institute and a global independent publishing house headquartered in Milan with more than 10 years of experience in the publishing field, with major shareholders from Europe and Asia. RLC is IAIR’s 2016 Company of the Year in Property Development (Philippines) for its leading role in the property development sector; for holding a strong position as a pioneer in the Philippines of mixed-use developments; and for becoming one of the most influential real estate developers in Asia. Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) is a leading real estate company in the Philippines. RLC is involved in the development and operation of shopping malls, offices and hotels and is one of the country’s most reputable developers of mixed-use properties, residential condominiums and residential housing developments including socialized housing projects located in key cities and other urban areas nationwide.
